column1: What is SAKTI?
column2: SAKTI is an AI-powered assistant that helps users discover Tamil Nadu government welfare schemes and understand their eligibility benefits and application details.

column1: How does SAKTI work?
column2: SAKTI uses artificial intelligence and a knowledge base of Tamil Nadu government schemes to find relevant schemes based on a user's needs and questions.

column1: What can SAKTI do?
column2: SAKTI can recommend schemes explain benefits provide eligibility information answer follow-up questions and support both English and Tamil queries.

column1: How do I search for schemes?
column2: Simply describe your requirement such as educational scholarships farmer subsidies women welfare schemes pensions housing assistance or business support.

column1: Can I ask questions in Tamil?
column2: Yes. SAKTI supports both Tamil and English and responds in the language used by the user whenever possible.

column1: Can I ask follow-up questions?
column2: Yes. After viewing schemes you can ask follow-up questions such as eligibility criteria benefits required documents and application procedures.

column1: How does the Show More feature work?
column2: The Show More feature displays additional scheme results related to your previous search query.

column1: How are schemes recommended?
column2: SAKTI analyzes your query and retrieves the most relevant schemes from its knowledge base using semantic search techniques.

column1: Does SAKTI submit applications?
column2: No. SAKTI only helps users discover and understand schemes. It does not submit applications on behalf of users.

column1: Is SAKTI an official government website?
column2: SAKTI is an informational assistant designed to help users navigate government schemes. Users should verify final details through official government sources.

column1: What information can I get about a scheme?
column2: SAKTI can provide information about benefits eligibility required documents implementing departments and application procedures.

column1: Can SAKTI explain eligibility criteria?
column2: Yes. SAKTI can explain who qualifies for a scheme and summarize eligibility requirements in simple language.

column1: Can SAKTI explain benefits?
column2: Yes. SAKTI can summarize financial assistance subsidies scholarships pensions and other benefits provided under a scheme.

column1: How accurate is SAKTI?
column2: SAKTI relies on the scheme data available in its knowledge base. Users should verify critical information using official government sources.

column1: Can I ask about education schemes?
column2: Yes. You can ask about scholarships fellowships student support hostel assistance laptop schemes and other education-related benefits.

column1: Can I ask about farmer schemes?
column2: Yes. You can ask about subsidies crop support irrigation assistance equipment support and other agriculture-related schemes.

column1: Can I ask about women welfare schemes?
column2: Yes. SAKTI can help identify schemes related to women welfare financial assistance entrepreneurship maternity support and social welfare.

column1: Can I ask about pension schemes?
column2: Yes. SAKTI can provide information about old age pensions widow pensions disability pensions and related welfare programs.

column1: Can I search without knowing the scheme name?
column2: Yes. You only need to describe your need or situation and SAKTI will try to find relevant schemes.

column1: Why did I get no results?
column2: No results may occur if there are no matching schemes in the current knowledge base or if the query is too specific. Try rephrasing your question.
